packageRules.description: A Python patch or lock maintenance (Pillow renders the fonts) reaches build output through the glyphs and titles the builds draw, which the render-diff CI job compares with the base, so those merge themselves. A minor or major can change more than that, and CI cannot rebuild without the ROMs, so it waits for a local rebuild and IPS comparison
Our own toolkit, pinned by tag in [tool.uv.sources]: no supply-chain cooldown; the pep621 manager updates uv.lock with it, and the patches still need a local rebuild before merging
